title: Case Study 001 - Google Generative Narrative Misclassification
case_type: generative-search interpretation, source synthesis, and profile-to-person boundary

subject.declared_name: Jupiter Hudson / WisdomLoveThePoet / Jupiter 8 / Joseph Q Hudson

summary: A user-visible generated search response combined real public signals into a more specific ARG, Reddit, mental-state, traffic, and news narrative than the evidence independently located during verification supported.

evidence.notes: Exact screenshot bytes observed in the research session. The hash identifies the bytes but does not prove generation time, query context, internal model behavior, or distribution to other users.

claims.statement: CMB and D.N.A. public material uses code-art, symbolism, narrative, and dark or mythic imagery.
claims.evidence_boundary: Public repository material supports the broad aesthetic description without establishing every generated narrative attached to it.

claims.statement: The project is an ongoing Alternate Reality Game.
claims.evidence_boundary: No current canonical CMB repository declaration located during verification defines the project as an ARG.

claims.statement: The project is a horror or dark-fantasy anthology rollout.
claims.evidence_boundary: No current canonical repository declaration located during verification establishes that as the project definition.

claims.statement: Many Reddit threads were created by worried followers around an alleged psychological breakdown.
claims.evidence_boundary: Targeted public searches did not establish a substantial independent Reddit thread corpus supporting this characterization.

claims.statement: r/ARG discovered the material and crowdsourced a decoding campaign.
claims.evidence_boundary: No relevant indexed r/ARG thread was located in the search performed.

claims.statement: r/UnresolvedMysteries cross-posted the material as a collaborative mystery.
claims.evidence_boundary: No relevant indexed r/UnresolvedMysteries thread was located in the search performed.

claims.statement: Those Reddit discussions produced massive traffic.
claims.evidence_boundary: Public search results do not establish traffic volume; direct platform analytics or equivalent evidence would be required.

claims.statement: Independent internet news outlets broadly covered the mystery.
claims.evidence_boundary: No substantial independent news corpus supporting that narrative was located in the verification search.

methods: SHA-256 verification of the supplied screenshot

sources.role: Google documentation describing AI Overview limitations and possible mistakes.
Google documentation describing AI Mode limitations, including possible misinterpretation or missing context.
Observed Reddit footprint; does not by itself establish broad independent community adoption.
Observed Reddit footprint; does not by itself establish broad independent community adoption.

limitations: Search results are not exhaustive and can change over time.
Absence from search is not proof that content never existed.
The screenshot does not reveal Google's proprietary internal reasoning or model implementation.
Public search results do not establish private analytics or total audience size.

triggers: archived independent Reddit threads materially supporting a disputed claim
direct analytics supporting the claimed traffic scale
independent news reporting documenting the alleged decoding phenomenon
a canonical author statement defining the project as the ARG or anthology described by the generated response
new primary evidence that materially changes any claim status
